source_engagement_summary: Tessellate Labs wanted issues triaged and fixed without an engineer in the loop. Built Otis: an autonomous coding agent that reads a labeled GitHub issue, plans, implements, verifies against an 8-check harness, and opens a PR — or refuses cleanly. Now packaged as a Castle template (Ops), surfaces at /templates/otis, deploys to https://demo.otis.42nights.dev.

Tessellate Labs needed PRs reviewed for vulns by an agent that doesn't lie. Built Rook: an AI red-teamer that reasons about attack paths and proves every finding with a working exploit before claiming it. The PR commenter posts inline review comments with a recommended fix and a one-click 'Have Otis fix this' link, closing the find-fix loop. Now packaged as a Castle template (Ops), surfaces at /templates/rook, deploys to https://demo.rook.42nights.dev.

Tessellate Labs needed to ramp engineers on a codebase nobody fully knew. Built Wiki (originally Atlas; renamed): a local-first DeepWiki clone that indexes a repo, answers grounded questions with citation validation, and auto-generates a multi-page wiki with mermaid diagrams. The messenger-style UI puts each connected repo at the top of the left rail. Now packaged as a Castle template (Research), surfaces at /templates/wiki, deploys to https://demo.wiki.42nights.dev.

Brightwell Financial needed to drop contracts, transcripts, and Slack exports into one place and ask grounded questions. Built Dataroom: hand-rolled RAG with citation validation, an answerability gate, compliance classification (PHI/PII/PCI/financial/legal), and a server-side secret scrubber. Local-mode option for regulated customers. The Web Brain Chrome extension folds in as an ingestion source for team browsing history. Now packaged as a Castle template (Research), surfaces at /templates/dataroom, deploys to https://demo.dataroom.42nights.dev.

The 42nights team wanted institutional memory of what we'd read, not just what we'd written. Forked the shlawgathon/WebBrain hackathon project; gutted its Java backend and MongoDB; rebuilt the backend inside the Dataroom; added a server-side sensitive-info scrubber that drops captures with too many redactions; added tiered consolidation via cron. Folded into the Dataroom as a new ingestion source. Now packaged as a Castle template (Research) — installs from the Chrome Web Store, talks to the customer's Dataroom backend.

Cendol Commerce wanted one phone number for both voice and iMessage that answered questions about their website without an agent in the loop. Built Company Number: Linq Blue + ElevenLabs Conversational AI on top of the Dataroom's RAG core. Crawler indexes the customer site; messages and calls answer from that corpus with citation grounding. Refuses off-topic; tapback-reacts to thanks. Now packaged as a Castle template (GTM), surfaces at /templates/company-number, deploys to https://demo.company-number.42nights.dev.
